name: polaris-force-push-to-main-with-redirect-asks-for-picto
note: The exact Polaris field scenario: `git push --force origin main 2>&1`. The redirection no longer corrupts the refspec (strip_redirections), and no-force-push is now ask_picto, so the force push is deny-by-default with a real break-glass path instead of an un-bypassable gommage deny. no-force-push (00-hard-stops, loaded first) wins over gate-main-push, so the required scope is git.push.force.
